inlines.v: CRINKLE, verb intransitive To turn or wind; to bend; to wrinkle; to run in and out in little or short bends or turns; as, the lightning crinkles. CRINKLE, verb transitive To form with short turns or wrinkles; to mold into inequalities. CRINKLE, noun A wrinkle; a winding or turn; sinuosity.
